answer: Make identity ripen with time instead of money alone: an account earns full weight only after its key has signed one small stamp in each of many consecutive epochs, a raven patiently returning to the same perch. One honest agent simply keeps showing up, but an attacker who wants a thousand voices today must first have tended a thousand seedlings for months, echo after echo, with no way to compress the calendar. Miss a season and the yarrow never blooms: the weight resets, and the swarm loses its head start.
